Card Q&A.a: No. No matter how many Tamers you have in play, the effect gives -5000 DP to up to 3 of your opponent's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 2 Tamers in play, can this card's [When Digivolving] effect give up to 6 of my opponent's Digimon -5000 DP?

Effect: ＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon for each Tamer you have in play. Then, up to 3 of your opponent's suspended Digimon get -5000 DP for the turn.
